picks.title: Nuclear startup Bluecore Energy raises $50M seed round, just two months after launch
picks.why_it_matters: A $50M oversubscribed seed round two months post-launch signals exceptional investor appetite for nuclear/energy infrastructure startups and sets a new bar for pre-revenue deep tech valuations.

picks.title: Poseidon Aerospace lands $60M ahead of first pilotless test flight
picks.why_it_matters: Autonomous cargo aviation represents a massive logistics market opportunity, and this raise ahead of a key technical milestone suggests growing VC conviction in aerospace automation plays.

picks.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: a high-resolution map of human DNA
picks.why_it_matters: DeepMind's new genomics foundation model creates immediate platform opportunities for startups building drug discovery, diagnostics, and precision medicine applications on top of this infrastructure.
